name: cdk-telemetry-observability-py-componentize
instr:
# Split the telemetry CDK app into components

Our telemetry observability CDK app (Python) builds every resource directly in four long stack constructors, so none of it is reusable. Please split it into components; the only deployed change should be one new tag.

## What we need

- Each component is a `Construct` subclass in `infra/components/<class_name_in_snake_case>.py`, at the given path under its stack (`<signal>` and `<subscriber>` are keys of the config's `signals` and `subscribers`). Its constructor takes `scope`, `id`, then exactly the props in parentheses as keyword arguments (anything else needs a default). Exposed attributes are child constructs: `foo_bar` is the child `FooBar` unless another ID follows in parentheses.
- `NetworkStack`: `NetworkFoundation` at `Network` (`cidr`, `max_azs`, `nat_gateways`) exposing `vpc`, `flow_log_group` (`FlowLogs`); `ArchiveEndpoint` at `ArchiveEndpoint` (`vpc`) exposing `endpoint`; `NetworkSecurity` at `Security` (`vpc`) exposing `ingress_security_group` (`PublicIngress`), `collector_security_group` (`Collector`), `endpoint_security_group` (`Endpoints`); `NetworkRegistry` at `Registry` (`stage`, `vpc`) exposing `primary_public_subnet_parameter` (`PrimaryPublicSubnet`), `private_subnet_registry_parameter` (`PrivateSubnets`).
- `DataStack`: `ArchiveStorage` at `Archive` (`stage`, `bucket_suffix`) exposing `telemetry_key` (`Key`), `archive_bucket` (`Bucket`); `SignalCatalog` at `Catalog` (`stage`, `encryption_key`) exposing `table
